'''Alpha moon''' was the designation given to [[Bessimir]]'s primary [[Moon/Legends|moon]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. When [[Operation Hammerblow]], the operational readiness exercise for the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet]], was initiated against the planet, the alpha moon housed the defenses primary antiship batteries, [[drone fighter]] hangars, and a [[HVs-2 hypervelocity gun]].
